在电脑端生成配对二维码，或复制配对链接。: Generate a pairing QR code or copy the pairing link on your computer.

填写电脑端提供的信息: Enter the details shown on your computer

配对码是否过期？可以在电脑端生成新的配对码。: Has the code expired? Generate a new pairing code on your computer.
